strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: i ṱola bogisi ḽa khii ḽa zwino kha mutevhe wa u bvisa wa Google (CRL) na u lingedza zwisima zwinzhi u swikela i tshi wana bogisi ḽa khii ḽi shumaho, na u vhulunga nga vhuḓiitisi na u thoma hafhu ha tshumelo dza Google. I gidima kha pompo inwe na inwe nahone i ṱoḓa inthanethe (mimunithi ya 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Bogisi ḽa khii u bva kha nethiweke: i ṱalutshedzela bogisi ḽa khii u bva kha vhupo ha ofishala (GitHub) nahone ya ḽi vhulunga kha /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. I ṱoḓa inthanethe nahone i dzhia mimunithi ya 1-3. I shumiswa musi smart fetch i tshi kundelwa kana musi keybox yo shandukiswa nga tshanḓa.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ṱhoḓisiso: i ṱola moduḽu dzi re hone dza u Ṋetshedza Khii dza Kule, i ṱola TEE mbekanyamushumo ya ṱhanziela ya u khwaṱhisedza, na u sumbedza tshiimo tsha tshishumiswa tsha KmInstallKeybox. A zwi shandukisi tshithu — mbonalo ya tshiimo tsha tshishumiswa tsho ḓoweleaho.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine ṱola (u vhala fhedzi): i sumbedza Widevine zwisumbedzi zwa ḽeveḽe (L1/L3) u bva kha dumpsys, u vha hone ha faila ya khii ya DRM (IDM), na pfaneleo dza sisiṱeme dzi tshimbilelanaho. A i shandukisi tshithu na luthihi.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manyuala RKP lugisa: u tshimbidza sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manyuala. I lugisa mafhungo a u khwaṱhisedza musi phase ya u ḓiitela i tshi kundelwa. U gidima huṅwe na huṅwe hu ganḓisa mutevhe wa u bvelela/u kundelwa u re khagala.
strings.mdRkpFull: • U lugisa RKP yo fhelelaho: u gidima sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh yo fhelelaho. U fara dzi case dzine dza vha uri dzo khwatha na u dzhia tshifhinga tshilapfu. Mvelelo i re khagala i vhonala mafheleloni.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Setha hafhu GMS: i bvisa datha ya tshumelo dza Play Store na Google (GMS+GSF) na u thoma hafhu tshishumiswa nga vhuḓiitisi. U itela u khwaṱhisedza ho khwaṱhaho fhedzi — a zwi vhuyi zwa kwama zwinepe kana faila dzaṋu.
strings.mdCertify: • Ṱhanziela ya u tamba: i ṱola tshiimo tsha khwaṱhisedzo ya ṱhanziela ya RKP ya tshishumiswa na u setha hafhu pfaneleo dza khwaṱhisedzo arali zwi tshi ṱoḓea. A i kwami ​​data ya mushumisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER u lugisa: u lugisa Google mafhungo a muhanga wa tshumelo (SOTER) a elanaho na u khwaṱhisedzwa ha tshishumiswa. I shumiswa kha zwiṅwe zwishumiswa zwine zwa ḓitika nga SOTER nṱhani ha Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • U shumisa PIF: u gidima sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh maanḓa. I shumisa minwe yo khethiwaho (yapo/ya nṱha) na u khwinisa faila dza pif.prop/pif.json. Mvelelo i re khagala i bvelela kha ḽogo.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF ṱola: i sumbedza tshiimo tsha injini yo dzheniswaho, faila dza minwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), na dziḽogo. Check fhedzi — a i shandukisi tshithu.
strings.mdCanary: • U khwiniswa ha Canary: u gidima sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. U dzhia mveledziso ya zwenezwino ya Canary Engine u vhona uri i a tendelana na ṱhanziela dza RKP dzine dza kombetshedzwa (Ṱhafamuhwe 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • U ṱola ha injini: i ṱola tshiimo tsha TrickyStoreOSS (pid, dziḽogi), faila dza bogisi ḽa khii (dzi shumaho vs mushumisi), minwe ya tshishumiswa tsha vhukuma vs tsho ṱanganyiswaho, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP khii. Display ya u ṱola fhedzi.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Zwikhala zwa mabogisi a khii (phuraimari / sekondari)
strings.hintKbSlots: Modulu u langa zwikhala zwivhili zwa keybox: zwa ndeme (zwikhethwa, zwi sa vhuyi zwa phumulwa) na zwa vhuvhili (zwa u vhulunga). Thebu iyi i sumbedza uri ndi tshikhala tshifhio tshine tsha khou shuma, u shandula zwine wa zwi takalela, kana u ṱuṱuwedza zwa vhuvhili u ya kha zwa phuraimari nga khumbelo yo ṱanḓavhuwaho — na dzibekhaphu na ḽogo yo fhelelaho.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • U ṱola vhuḓifulufheli: u ṱola u dzheniswa ha khii dza TEE, u ṱhavhelwa ha ḽaiburari nga ngomu ha keystore2, tshiimo tsha u bvisa (CRL), u katelwa ha mutevhe wa tsireledzo na tshiimo tsha RKP. U vhala fhedzi — a zwi shandukisi tshithu.

Bvela phanḓa?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Zwikhala zwa bogisi ḽa khii: zwi sumbedza tshiimo tsha zwikhala zwa phuraimari na zwa sekondari na u shandula zwine zwa takalelwa vhukati hazwo. Phuraimari (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) i dzula yo tsireledzwa nahone a i vhuyi ya phumulwa. U ṱuṱuwedza sekondari u ya kha phuraimari zwi ṱoḓa khwaṱhisedzo yo ṱanḓavhuwaho.
